paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: Evaluation of our models and LLaMA-3-8B-inst.
model_annotation: This vertical grouped bar chart illustrates "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks." The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Dataset and Metrics," displaying nine datasets with diagonally rotated labels in the following order: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis, labeled "Score (%)," displays a continuous linear scale ranging from 0 to 80 with tick marks at regular intervals of 10. For each dataset on the horizontal axis, two grouped vertical bars are presented side-by-side to represent different models, as specified by the top-right legend. Within each group, the left bar is blue, representing the "LLaMA-3-8B-it" model, and the right bar is orange, representing the "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" model. The highest overall values appear in the GSM-8K category, where the blue bar reaches approximately 79.5% and the orange bar reaches the peak value of approximately 80.5%. The shortest bars are located in the Chat-Arena-Hard category, where the blue bar is roughly 20.5% and the orange bar is around 29%. Across the other categories, the blue and orange bars report approximate respective values of 65.5% and 65% for MMLU, 61.5% and 64% for HumanEval, 44% and 60% for TruthfulQA, 59% and 64% for ARC, 61% and 60.5% for MBPP, 22.5% and 31% for LC AlpacaEval-2, and 41% and 42% for MT-Bench (x5). The categories are not strictly sorted by ascending or descending value, though the highest-scoring categories generally appear on the left, and no specific bars are visually emphasized with outlines, bolding, or annotations.
